supp_context.consequences.caption: source record SRC-S61. Recorded consequences among damage reports
supp_context.consequences.note: All numeric table entries are report counts, not hours or monetary amounts. National and eight-target totals precede the individual targets. Recorded denotes a nonmissing source value; zero here can mean that no report has a recorded value. Underlying nonmissing downtime values are in hours and cost values are nominal US dollars; all such values in this cohort are positive. Missing values remain unavailable. Nonaffirmative engine flags do not certify absence of damage. Effect recorded counts a nonmissing EFFECT entry and does not necessarily indicate an adverse flight effect.

supp_context.consequence_amounts.caption: source record SRC-S62. Recorded downtime and repair-cost summaries with missingness
supp_context.consequence_amounts.note: Denominators are eligible damage reports. Hours and repair medians use only available values; costs are nominal US dollars. Missing values are unavailable, not zero. Summed hours describe documented aircraft downtime, not staff review time or complete burden. These consequences are not attributed to model error. Available repair counts can be as small as one; medians are descriptive.
